theorems.name: Submission.dohr_c1_graph_mass_pinching
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (R : ℝ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 R) → ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) R, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ η → ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - ε) ^ n / (1 + ε) ^ n * (unitBallVolume n * r ^ n)) ≤ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (graphOver u (ball 0 R) ∩ closedBall (graphPoint x (u x)) r) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (graphOver u (ball 0 R) ∩ closedBall (graphPoint x (u x)) r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + ε) ^ n / (1 - ε) ^ n * (unitBallVolume n * r ^ n))
